_comment: Projects that use each bundle, keyed by the bundle's groupId:artifactId. After a producer job (mvn-rebundle, mvn-rebundle-change) publishes a version of the bundle, it starts mvn-rebundle-consumer for every project listed here with that version; apply=true lets the consumer job edit the POMs on a branch and push it for review, apply=false only writes the proposal. Replace the placeholders with real repositories.
